item.title: IDF claims to have taken out Hamas commander who participated in Oct 7
item.description: The IDF announced it killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Anas Hamed in a targeted Gaza airstrike, saying he raided Israel during the Oct. 7 Nova massacre.

item.title: Lindsey Graham urges US, Israel to arm Iranian civilians in 'Second Amendment solution' to topple regime
item.description: Sen. Lindsey Graham urged a "Second Amendment solution" for Iran, arguing the U.S. and Israel should arm civilians to overthrow the Islamic regime.
